note: Features whose Playwright spec exists but cannot yet cover the whole §16.2 scenario. Each entry says what is pending and which task owns it. Never fake or skip a test to remove an entry: finish the scenario, then delete the entry. scripts/check-e2e-coverage.mjs counts these as PARTIAL; E9X_E2E_GATE=strict fails while any remains.

features.pending: 'chưa xác thực thì không mua được gói' through the checkout SCREEN: POST /api/orders already refuses an unverified learner (F39 asserts urn:e9x:problem:email-not-verified at the real endpoint, OrderServiceIT.unverifiedEmailCannotOrder), but there is no plan/checkout page yet, so the browser scenario (open a plan, try to pay, get refused, verify, the same order goes through) is pending.

'AUTHOR IELTS không thấy/không sửa được câu TOEIC' and 'REVIEWER không duyệt được bản mình soạn' through the CMS screens: needs the question editor and the review workflow. Today: the exam a role is granted for travels from invitation to grants, the server's Authz answers per exam (canReviewOwnVersion is false), and the screens an AUTHOR/REVIEWER can open.

'danh sách khoá/lớp đổi theo': there are no courses or classes yet. Today the data that changes with the context is the organisation's members and roles, the menus the roles open, and the switcher; the course and class lists must be asserted in the same two-organisation setup.

'mở URL lớp/khoá riêng của tổ chức B → 404': there is no class or course page or endpoint yet. Today the same scenario runs against the organisation-owned pages and endpoints that exist (members, roles, invitations) in the browser and over HTTP; the class and course URLs must be added.

Done through the real stack (P2.3): editing a published question makes a new draft version and never touches the published one, one open version per question, a colleague cannot take a draft over, the new version is published only by a review (run by seed.reviewVersion, the real ReviewService, until the review screens exist). Pending: 'học viên đang thi vẫn thấy bản cũ' (a learner IN an exam keeps reading the version the attempt began on: no exam room exists yet) and the side-by-side comparison of two versions (diff screen) and the approval by a person in the review queue.
features.owner: P3.4 (exam room: the attempt keeps its version), P2.9 (review queue and version comparison)
